event.title: Highest temperature in Munich on August 1?
event.description:

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: The market-implied odds overwhelmingly favor a 35°C high in Tokyo on August 1 because official Japan Meteorological Agency forecasts and ensemble model guidance project that exact peak under a dominant subtropical high-pressure ridge promoting clear skies, subsidence warming, and light winds. Current surface observations show temperatures already approaching or exceeding 32°C by mid-morning, consistent with seasonal August climatology augmented by the urban heat island effect from Tokyo’s dense built environment. Resolution hinges on the official daily maximum recorded at the Tokyo station; minor deviations could occur from localized convective clouds or a brief sea breeze shift, though such changes appear unlikely given the stable synoptic pattern and minimal model spread.
